records.key: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars and cells. Density changes their population independently of detail; rendering stays within the screen's pixel budget.
records.source: How many things there are: blobs, aurora curtains, ripple sources, stars and cells. Density changes their population independently of detail; rendering stays within the screen's pixel budget.
records.translation: Quantos elementos existem: manchas de cor, cortinas de aurora, fontes de ondulações, estrelas e células. A densidade altera sua quantidade independentemente do nível de detalhe; a renderização permanece dentro do orçamento de píxeis da tela.
